title: Update on Government's Study on Use of Sustainable Aviation Fuels
what_it_is: Update on Government's Study on Use of Sustainable Aviation Fuels

sections.label: Sustainable aviation fuels and CORSIA
sections.summary: A study on sustainable aviation fuel at Changi Airport presented integration options and feedstock combinations, and Singapore is participating in CORSIA's voluntary phase.

sentences.speaker: Mr Leon Perera
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Transport (a) whether he can provide an update on the Government’s study on the use of sustainable aviation fuels in the local aviation industry; and (b) whether Singapore’s readiness to participate in the voluntary phase of the Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation has been delayed by the impact of COVID-19 on the aviation industry and, if so, what is the extent of the delay.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: However, it is important to note that today, sustainable aviation fuels are two to five times more expensive than conventional jet fuel.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: The Singapore Government and our industry partners have conducted a study of the operational and commercial viability of sustainable aviation fuels at Changi Airport.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: The study presented options to integrate these fuels with traditional jet fuel at Changi Airport, such as at existing jet fuel facilities, or at tank terminals in the existing supply chain; in other words, where it is the most efficient way to integrate this within the supply chain for jet fuels.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: It also identified viable feedstock-technology combinations for sustainable aviation fuel production in Singapore, based on the availability of feedstock in the region, cost and life-cycle assessments.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: The report also suggested various options to facilitate uptake and production of sustainable aviation fuels in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: Despite COVID-19, Singapore is participating in the voluntary phase of the International Civil Aviation Organization’s (ICAO) Carbon Offsetting and Reduction Scheme for International Aviation (CORSIA), which aims to cap the international aviation sector’s emissions.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Transport (Mr S Iswaran)
sentences.text: The Civil Aviation Authority of Singapore (CAAS) and Singapore-based carriers, namely Jetstar Asia, Scoot and Singapore Airlines, are monitoring and reporting the airlines’ emissions under CORSIA.

sections.label: Studying sustainable aviation fuel exports
sections.summary: Agencies are studying how to produce sustainable aviation fuels not only for Singapore's needs but also for export.

sentences.speaker: Mr S Iswaran
sentences.text: In fact, it is something that our agencies are studying; how we can not just produce these sustainable aviation fuels for our own needs, but also be available for export.
